schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: VIS-IR imaging spectroscopy, acquired before the section was prepared — the fragment was embedded and polished "after the SPectral IMager (SPIM) reflectance spectroscopy imagery acquisition" and only then carbon coated "for further SEM-EDS and EMPA-WDS analyses" (p.3). The SEM work is then registered to those images: "To cover approximately the same area of the SPIM images (9.7 mm large), 10 BSE images, with four consecutive images in the same row, were acquired and mosaicked" (p.3)

schema:location.schema:name: CNR IMAA (Institute of Methodologies for Environmental Analysis), Italian National Research Council, Potenza, Italy

prov:wasGeneratedBy.schema:description: SE imaging used for topographic examination; instrument capability: up to ×200,000 magnification, 5 nm resolution; SE acquired before EDS to minimize charging effects

schema:step.schema:name: Sample preparation
schema:step.schema:description: Embedded in epoxy, polished to ¼ µm level, sputtered with 30-nm-thick carbon film

schema:target.schema:name: BSE Imaging (Zeiss Supra 40 FE-SEM); EDS (Zeiss Supra 40 FE-SEM); EMPA-WDS (JEOL JXA-8230, separate instrument); VIS-IR spectroscopy (SPIM)

ada:samplingUnitName: Sample name only — "the NWA 7317 slab" (p.3), imaged on "almost the same portion of the VIS-IR SPIM images" (p.4); imaged fields and analysis points are not labelled
